concerns.text: Task T011a (Fetch Coefficients) is marked as FAILED/UNSPECIFIED. This task is a hard prerequisite for T017a (Preprocessing) which implements FR-003 (Degree-1/C20 correction). Without a defined task to fetch these coefficients, the implementation of FR-003 is impossible.

Task T017b (NOAA Preprocessing) is marked as FAILED/UNSPECIFIED. This task is required to produce the input artifacts for T017c (Merge) and satisfies FR-002 (NOAA ingestion/aggregation). The missing definition blocks the entire data pipeline.

Task T017c (Merge & Validation) is marked as FAILED/UNSPECIFIED. It depends on T017a/b outputs. Without a defined task to merge and validate the dataset against the schema (T013), FR-001/FR-002 data completeness and SC-001 cannot be verified.

Task T020b (Runtime Profiling) is marked as pending ([]). This task is a prerequisite for T040 (Runtime Measurement) which validates SC-004 (6h runtime limit). The lack of a defined profiling task leaves the performance constraint unverified.
Task T040 (Runtime Measurement) is marked as pending ([]). It depends on T020b. Without this task, the project cannot validate SC-004 (Runtime ≤ 6h), leaving a critical success criterion unaddressed.

Task T045 (Reconcile Run-Book) is marked as pending ([]). This task ensures the quickstart documentation matches the final script names (e.g., 06_visualization_timeseries.py vs 04_visualization.py). Without it, FR-007 (Documentation) and user onboarding are at risk of inconsistency.

Tasks T050, T051, and T052 (Theoretical Frame/Review Resolution) are marked as pending ([]). These tasks address the 'albert-einstein-simulated' review regarding the frame of reference (FR-003/SC-001 context). Without these, the theoretical ambiguity remains unresolved before analysis.

Task T007c populates URLs with generic homepages (e.g., 'https://grace.jpl.nasa.gov/data/get-data/') rather than direct API endpoints. While the task exists, the description implies the URLs are 'actual canonical URLs' but lists generic pages, creating a potential implementation gap for T015/T016.
